defects.title: Timezone Drift in Refund Calculations
defects.description: Time offset logic computes incorrect hours when comparing transaction timestamps on local Windows servers running under UTC+7.
defects.steps:
1. Deploy the test environment on a host using the `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh` timezone.
2. Submit a booking cancellation request exactly 13 hours prior to slot start.
3. Inspect the refund percentage.
defects.expected: Refund rate calculations return 100% (since cancellation occurs $> 12$h before slot).
defects.actual: Refund rate calculations return 70% (computed difference is skewed to 6 hours due to raw UTC drift).
defects.suggestedFix: Sử dụng giờ VN thay vì Date.getUTCHours().

defects.title: Missing success field in PayOS Mock Response
defects.description: Checkouts fail with error notifications on checkout redirects.
defects.steps:
1. Trigger checkout links by calling `/api/payments/create`.
2. Inspect payment checkout responses.
defects.expected: Generates a valid payment redirect link.
defects.actual: Call fails with exception message: `"Không thể tạo payment PayOS: Unknown error"`.
defects.suggestedFix: Bổ sung success: true trong mock.
